title: Expense Agent: Mileage Allowances (2026 release wave 1)

chapters.title: Selecting routes and automatic rate calculation
Route selection and shortest route option

features.name: Mileage expense creation
features.description: Employees can submit travel expenses using a mileage feature in the expense agent by selecting starting and ending points on a map.

features.name: Multi-route selection
features.description: Users can choose from up to three different route options between starting and ending points when creating a mileage expense.

features.name: Automatic mileage rate calculation
features.description: The system automatically calculates the expense amount based on distance and admin-configured mileage rates.

features.name: Round trip toggle
features.description: A toggle option allows users to mark an expense as a round trip, which doubles the distance and amount calculated.

features.name: Mileage rate configuration
features.description: Administrators can configure the mileage rate per unit (default is miles) and select the default unit of distance (miles or kilometers).

features.name: Shortest route enforcement option
features.description: Administrators can enable a toggle on the Expense Agent Setup page to enforce the shortest route selection, preventing users from choosing multiple routes.

features.name: Automatic expense report matching
features.description: The expense agent automatically processes mileage expenses and attempts to match and add them to existing expense reports.
